notes.title: Wishlist Bonk The Goblins!

My third game is Bonk The Goblins! It is a mix of Whackamole, Microgames from series like WarioWare, with visual style similar to Pizza Tower, and of course bursting with goblins!

Bonk The Goblins! it is coming very soon!
